title: potentilla cinerea subsp. incana
intro: Potentilla cinerea subsp. incana, commonly known as a type of flowering plant, is a subspecies of Potentilla cinerea. It is a shrubby perennial plant that produces clusters of small, white flowers and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Potentilla cinerea subsp. incana include its potential to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory, anti-viral, and anti-bacterial properties.
